name: MediaSpark – Media Library Organizer
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
MediaSpark transforms your chaotic WordPress media library into a perfectly organized, SEO-optimized powerhouse — 100% free.

Key Features:
– Unlimited hierarchical folders (virtual – no file moving)
– Media tags for advanced filtering
– Auto-generate alt text & tags from filename on upload
– Bulk edit folders, tags, and alt text (up to 50 items in list view)
– SEO analytics: unused media, missing alt texts, folder stats
– Filter media by folder/tag directly in the Media Library
– Sortable “Count” column in folder/tag admin screens
– Fast, lightweight, fully compatible with Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, WooCommerce

No physical folders. No broken URLs. Just pure organization.

Upgrade to MediaSpark Pro for unlimited bulk edits, grid mode editing, AI alt text, image compression, watermarking & more.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mediaspark folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Media > MediaSpark to configure settings and view analytics
  4. Use the Media Library filters and bulk actions to organize!
sections.faq:
Are folders real or virtual?

Virtual taxonomies — file URLs never change. 100% safe and fast.

Can I bulk edit in grid view?

Free: List view only (50 items). Pro: Grid + list, unlimited.

Is it compatible with page builders?

Yes! Works perfectly with Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, Brizy, etc.

How does auto alt text work?

Takes the first two words from the filename (after removing dashes/underscores).
